saints.name: John Capistran
saints.legacy: Defender of the faith and reformer
saints.summary: John Capistran was an Italian Franciscan friar known for his powerful preaching and dedication to reforming the Church. He played a significant role in the defense of Christian territories during the Ottoman threat, notably leading a successful crusade at Belgrade in 1456. Canonized in 1690, he is remembered for his humility, perseverance, and the numerous miracles attributed to him after his death.

saints.name: Gontran
saints.legacy: A compassionate king and protector of peace.
saints.summary: Saint Gontran was the King of Burgundy and Orleans, known for his piety and dedication to his subjects. He ruled during a time of division among his brothers and sought to maintain peace and justice in his realm. His legacy includes the establishment of churches and monasteries, as well as a reputation for mercy and compassion towards the oppressed.
